title: FoodNest — Scalable Full-Stack Food Ordering Platform
tagline: Multi-tier RBAC ecosystem with PostgreSQL, live GPS routing, Razorpay, and AI assistant
summary: Production-grade full-stack food delivery ecosystem with role-based access control for Customers, Vendors, and Admins. Features 25+ REST APIs, automated DB migrations, real-time order tracking, distance-calculated restaurant discovery via GPS, server-side verified Razorpay payments, OTP authentication, and an integrated AI support chatbot.
architecture: Client: React (Vite) Single Page Application with dynamic cart and live order status. Backend: Express.js REST API with JWT middleware, bcrypt password hashing, and role guard authorization. Database: PostgreSQL with automated table migration and seed script. Third-party integrations: Razorpay test mode with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification fallback, Cloudinary media CDN, and GPS distance haversine calculations.
interviewPoints: Engineered 3-tier RBAC (Customer, Vendor, Admin) with granular permission guards preventing privilege escalation.
Implemented server-side HMAC-SHA256 signature verification for Razorpay payment webhooks to thwart client tamper attempts.
Integrated Haversine GPS sorting on PostgreSQL coordinates to query nearest kitchens within sub-15ms latency.
Designed resilient fallback gateway so the app functions seamlessly in local sandbox and production cloud environments.

title: CipherShield — AI-Powered Fraud Detection & Fair Decision Verification
tagline: Real-time SOC platform with RandomForest ML, SHA-256 hash-chain audit, and simulated ZK proofs
summary: Fintech security and fraud detection platform engineered to operate like a real Security Operations Center (SOC). Leverages a trained RandomForestClassifier for real-time transaction anomaly detection, coupled with a tamper-evident SHA-256 single-writer hash-chain audit trail and a zero-knowledge proof verification pipeline. Features live Socket.IO alerts and an automated attack simulator covering impossible travel, rapid velocity, and VPN proxy spoofery.
architecture: Hybrid dual-service backend: Python FastAPI microservice serving Scikit-Learn fraud model inference; Node.js/Express orchestration backend with PostgreSQL database and Socket.IO WebSocket broadcaster; React frontend with live SOC radar, Recharts analytics, and case management dashboard.
interviewPoints: Trained and serialized RandomForestClassifier with balanced class weighting to maximize precision against extreme fraud imbalance.
Constructed a cryptographic SHA-256 hash-chain in PostgreSQL where every audit row embeds the cryptographic digest of its ancestor.
Engineered real-time impossible travel detection calculating geographical velocity between sequential card transactions.
Demonstrated transparent engineering trade-offs between simulated Zero-Knowledge SnarkJS proofs and production elliptic-curve circuits.

title: NetSentinel AI Pro — AI Network Intrusion Detection System (NIDS)
tagline: PCAP & real-time traffic analysis combining Isolation Forest + RF with interactive security lab
summary: End-to-end AI-powered Network Intrusion Detection System (NIDS) converting raw network packets and PCAP captures into actionable threat intelligence. Combines Scapy packet decoding, flow generation, 9 engineered TCP/IP features, Isolation Forest anomaly detection, and signature rules to detect SYN floods, DoS vectors, and port scans with an interactive security dashboard and educational networking lab.
architecture: Engineered with a high-throughput Scapy PCAP parsing engine generating bi-directional network flows; dual-model ML detection pipeline (Isolation Forest for unsupervised zero-day anomaly detection + Random Forest for supervised attack classification); FastAPI backend with SQLite/Postgres storage; React dashboard with interactive packet stream inspector and virtual computer networking laboratory.
interviewPoints: Engineered 9 high-signal flow features from raw PCAP packets (duration, byte rate, packet count, SYN/ACK ratios, inter-arrival time).
Built hybrid detection pipeline: deterministic rules capture known signatures instantly while Isolation Forest catches novel zero-day anomalies.
Containerized complete stack with Docker multi-stage builds and automated deployment to Render cloud.
Built interactive educational networking laboratory demonstrating OSI 7 layers, Dijkstra shortest path routing, and TCP 3-way handshakes.

title: TruthGuard — Multi-Agent Multimodal AI Deception & Deepfake Detection
tagline: Multi-agent LLM & Computer Vision system for real-time deepfake, misinformation, and scam detection
summary: Distributed multi-agent AI system for detecting multimodal digital deception, disinformation, synthetic deepfakes, and social-engineering scam vectors. Orchestrates specialized agents (Text Claim Verifier, Vision Deepfake Analyzer, Evidence Retrieval Agent, Source Credibility Scorer) to conduct cross-modal reasoning and generate transparent forensic reports.
architecture: Hierarchical multi-agent framework: Orchestrator agent splits incoming multimedia into modal streams; Vision agent performs CNN/transformer artifact analysis on facial features; Text agent conducts claim extraction and LLM semantic cross-examination; RAG agent queries ChromaDB vector embeddings against authenticated knowledge bases; Synthesis agent compiles weighted forensic veracity scores.
interviewPoints: Overcame single-modality detection limits by designing a cross-modal verification loop that correlates image metadata with textual claims.
Implemented ChromaDB vector similarity search to ground claim verification in authoritative source corpora, preventing hallucinated evaluations.
Designed explainable AI forensic reports that highlight specific pixel artifacts, text sentiment inconsistencies, and source domain risks.

title: INTERFOG — Energy-Aware Fog Computing Scheduler
tagline: Probability-of-completion task scheduling for edge/fog nodes powered by harvested energy
summary: Novel edge/fog computing scheduling system designed for nodes powered by harvested energy (solar, vibration, RF). Uses survival analysis and probabilistic calibration to answer: 'Will the task finish before the battery runs dry?'. Evaluates P(Completion | Harvest Rate, Battery, Load) and dynamically schedules or offloads tasks to prevent node depletion.
architecture: Energy-harvesting stochastic model coupled with dynamic execution runtime. Telemetry ingestion simulates intermittent ambient power inputs while a calibrated survival probability estimator decides whether to execute locally, throttle frequency, or offload to neighboring fog clusters.
interviewPoints: Formulated mathematical objective: P(Task Completion | Battery, Harvest Rate, Workload, Deadline).
Engineered adaptive threshold heuristics to eliminate task termination mid-execution due to battery exhaustion.
Constructed live interactive web dashboard deployed on Render visualizing real-time battery charge, harvest cycles, and task queues.

title: Titan Ascent: The Living Mountain — 3D Browser Adventure
tagline: Immersive Three.js browser game with breathing terrain physics, grappling hooks, and 14 quests
summary: Immersive 3D browser game where the player climbs the back of a colossal, breathing titan under celestial planets. Features dynamic terrain deformation linked to the titan's breath cycles ('Perfect breath' leaps), stamina/grip physics, rope-hook grappling mechanics, 6 distinct ecological biomes, 4 tribes with 14 quests and 30 branching dialogue paths, and 3 distinct narrative endings.
architecture: Engineered with zero commercial game engine — entirely hand-written vanilla JavaScript and Three.js shaders. Custom heightmap deformation algorithm updates vertex geometry with sinusoidal breath rhythms; procedural audio generator utilizes Web Audio API; modular quest state machine drives branching dialogue.
interviewPoints: Implemented real-time vertex displacement in WebGL meshes synchronized with breathing audio loops.
Built complete climbing and raycasted grappling-hook physics system with stamina management and friction calculations.
Created 30-branch dialogue state machine with persistent player karma influencing 3 distinct cinematic endings.

title: CloudMind — AI-Powered Cloud Infrastructure & ML Autoscaling
tagline: Predictive cloud resource orchestration platform with FastAPI, JWT/RBAC, and ML forecasting
summary: Cloud orchestration and predictive autoscaling system designed for high-density microservices. Implements resource management across 6 tiers (users, projects, applications, environments, clusters, deployments) secured with JWT and RBAC. Employs XGBoost and LSTM forecasting models to predict traffic spikes and autonomously preempt autoscaling delays.
architecture: FastAPI core API microservice managing relational entities in PostgreSQL; Kafka event bus streaming metrics; ML forecasting service with XGBoost for CPU/memory estimation and LSTM sequence modeling for seasonal traffic spikes; Dockerized container deployments with Kubernetes manifests and Terraform IaC.
interviewPoints: Designed clean 6-level relational resource hierarchy with strict foreign key constraints and multi-tenant isolation.
Formulated proactive autoscaling algorithm to solve traditional reactive autoscaler lag (cold-start mitigation).
Structured framework-agnostic REST API design enabling clean migration or interoperability with Spring Boot services.

title: Browser Extension Risk Auditor — Manifest V3 Security Platform
tagline: Intelligent security and permission risk evaluation platform with live Chrome extension inspector
summary: Security assessment platform that audits installed browser extensions, inspects declarative permissions, maps CSP policies, identifies high-risk APIs (webRequest, cookies, nativeMessaging), and computes deterministic threat severity scores with actionable remediation guides.
architecture: Chrome Extension frontend built on Manifest V3 declarative APIs; Node.js/Express backend service running algorithmic risk scoring matrix; PostgreSQL database logging extension telemetry; React dashboard visualizing permission graphs and security recommendations.
interviewPoints: Engineered heuristic risk scoring model penalizing toxic permission combinations (e.g., broad host permissions combined with background script network exfiltration).
Audited Chrome Web Store Manifest V3 compliance standards including declarativeNetRequest and service worker lifecycles.
Deployed full-stack dashboard on Render offering one-click security audits for non-technical users.

title: PARADOX — 60 Seconds Ahead: Sci-Fi Time-Loop Browser Game
tagline: Cinematic neon browser game with 60-second deterministic foresight and temporal replays
summary: Neon sci-fi browser game where the player perceives 60 seconds into the future and must maneuver to break a deterministic death loop. Features deterministic timeline visualization, reactive enemy AI, foresight pulse mechanics, paradox energy meter, instant temporal replays, and persistent high-score backend.
architecture: Canvas 2D render loop running at 60 FPS; state history buffer recording player trajectory and simulating ahead timeline predictions; Express.js leaderboard backend handling persistent run scores.
interviewPoints: Engineered deterministic prediction engine that renders dual timelines simultaneously on canvas without frame drops.
Built cinematic death replay system serializing input coordinates into instant flashback playback.
Designed full cyberpunk UI/UX with responsive mobile touch controls and keyboard bindings.

title: Generative AI Career Copilot — Powered by IBM watsonx
tagline: Enterprise GenAI solution using IBM watsonx foundation models for ATS-optimized resume synthesis
summary: Enterprise generative AI tool engineered during IBM internship leveraging IBM watsonx foundation models. Dynamically synthesizes ATS-optimized resumes and contextual cover letters tailored to target job descriptions, utilizing zero-shot and few-shot prompt chaining.
architecture: Client web interface connected to IBM watsonx AI runtime; structured prompt engineering pipeline embedding job description keywords, candidate skill vectors, and strict anti-hallucination constraints.
interviewPoints: Applied enterprise Responsible AI principles and prompt governance learned during IBM watsonx certification.
Formulated prompt chaining pipeline separating content extraction, keyword alignment, and tone modulation.
Reduced resume and cover letter drafting turnaround by 80% while preserving ATS formatting compliance.

title: Stock Price Predictor — Financial Time-Series ML Model
tagline: Quantitative machine learning model for historical stock trend forecasting and technical indicators
summary: AI financial forecasting project utilizing time-series machine learning algorithms to analyze historical stock patterns, detect market inflection points, and assist quantitative decision-making.
architecture: Jupyter Notebook & Python workflow incorporating Yahoo Finance data extraction, missing value imputation, rolling window feature extraction (moving averages, momentum indicators), and regression model evaluation.
interviewPoints: Engineered lag features and moving average indicators to capture non-linear financial market dependencies.
Conducted rigorous train-test splitting avoiding look-ahead bias in financial backtesting.
Visualized prediction confidence intervals using Matplotlib.
